Ned'Cirannis, named in-game as Dissected Drow, was an Absolute cultist who died during a scouting mission in Act One. His corpse was brought to the Emerald Grove for dissection.

Involvement

Act One

Ned's corpse is lying on a table in the Enclave Library at X: -445 Y: 20. Although he received strict orders from  Minthara to observe and not engage, Ned attacked  Halsin and  Nettie with a group of goblins. The druids killed him and a tadpole crawled out of his head.

Speak with Dead

Ned can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Dissected Drow
      Ned'Cirannis... of the Absolute...
  • What happened to you?
    • Dissected Drow
      Scouting... found druids...
  • Who killed you?
    • Dissected Drow
      Druid... Bear...
  • How many drow are out there?
    • Dissected Drow
      Minthara... back at camp...
  • Where did you get your tadpole?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It doesn't understand the question.*
      • Where did you start following the Absolute?
        • Dissected Drow
          Moonrise Towers... initiation...
      • Were you abducted by mind flayers?
        • Dissected Drow
          No...
  • [DROW] Your name and House. Now.
    • Dissected Drow
      Ned'Cirannis... of the Absolute...
      • [DROW] There is no House of the Absolute.
        • Dissected Drow
          No houses... all equal in Her love...
      • [DROW] Why would you serve? Drow are born to rule.
        • Dissected Drow
          We will... Absolute will rule all...
